title: mri_synthmorph
description: SynthMorph is a deep-learning tool for brain-specific MRI image registration without preprocessing.

moving_image.description: The moving input image, which will be registered to the fixed image.
moving_image.title: Moving Image

fixed_image.description: The fixed input image, which is used as the reference for registration.
fixed_image.title: Fixed Image

transform_output.description: Output transform file for registration. Can be a text file for linear or an image file for deformable registration.
transform_output.title: Output Transform

header_only.description: Adjust the voxel-to-world matrix instead of resampling. Linear registration only.
header_only.title: Header Only Flag

transformation_model.description: Specifies the registration transformation model. Options include 'deform', 'affine', and 'rigid'.
transformation_model.title: Transformation Model

threads.description: Number of TensorFlow threads to utilize. Defaults to the number of cores.
threads.title: Number of Threads

gpu_flag.description: Utilize the GPU specified by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES or GPU 0 if unset or empty.
gpu_flag.title: Use GPU

smooth.description: Regularization parameter for deformable registration. Higher values indicate smoother displacement fields.
smooth.title: Smoothness

extent.description: Isotropic extent of the registration space in unit voxels.
extent.title: Extent

model_weights.description: Alternative model weights as an H5 file.
model_weights.title: Model Weights

inspect_directory.description: Save model inputs resampled into network space for inspection.
inspect_directory.title: Inspect Directory
